ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Dressing Room uses your camera to photograph clothes for your closet or to compare a piece with it.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Dressing Room uses the photos you pick to add clothes to your closet or to compare a piece with it.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Dressing Room uses your location once to find your city, so outfit suggestions can match the weather.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Dressing Room uses the microphone only while you tap to dictate a city, an occasion or a message to your stylist.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Dressing Room turns what you dictate into text to fill in a city, pick an occasion or write to your stylist.
